name: component-intelligence-archive
description: Portable workflow for researching, validating, and preparing Component Intelligence archive changes against the production GitHub authority.

interface.longDescription: Research, review, and validate Component Intelligence archive work using jackp803/Component-Intelligence-Public main as the authoritative governance source. Central write actions remain capability-gated and must follow validation, readback, and sync rules.
defaultPrompt: Archive a new component using the Component Intelligence rules.
Review an existing Components / Ports / Pins record for archive readiness.
Prepare and validate an archive changeset without writing it.
